_doc: Per-engine text for the preamble, egress port, source clone under /refs, lane and time caps. Same schema as the cold-agent kit's sandbox/engines.json plus: lane (gpu|cpu), agent_s / rerun_s (override _defaults), minutes (expected agent minutes, for balancing VMs), ref_repo / ref_tag_fmt / ref_pypi (read-only clone made by vm/prepare.sh). Any value containing TODO blocks a launch for that engine. declines: groups (or request ids) where the engine's public docs say it cannot do the job: a decline there is a correct decline and the request is not 'supported' for that engine. image = the sandbox image tag built by images/build.sh (engine pre-installed, caches warm). notice (optional): the arm's results may not be published; every output with its rows starts with the notice and --public leaves them out. More arms or fields can come from $NEWENV_EXTRA_CONFIG/engines.json.

alloy.name: Alloy
alloy.install: Alloy is a physics engine built on NVIDIA Newton and Warp (the import name is `alloy`; PyTorch is installed beside it). It is already installed (with its caches warm) in the Python environment of `~/alloy/.venv`, first on PATH: `python` imports it; do not reinstall it, and add other packages with pip only if you need them. Its source repository is checked out at `~/alloy` (a clone of the public repository).
alloy.docs: the repository at `~/alloy` (README.md, docs/, examples/, the code and tests), plus Newton's docs at https://newton-physics.github.io/newton/ and Warp's at https://nvidia.github.io/warp/

maniskill.name: ManiSkill
maniskill.install: ManiSkill 3.0.1 is the PyPI package `mani_skill` (`import mani_skill`), installed with PyTorch. It is already installed (with its caches warm) in the Python environment first on PATH: `python` imports it; do not reinstall it, and add other packages with pip only if you need them.
maniskill.docs: https://maniskill.readthedocs.io (see the custom tasks tutorial), and its source repository cloned read-only at `/refs/maniskill`

playground.name: MuJoCo Playground
playground.install: MuJoCo Playground 1.0.1 is the PyPI package `playground` (`import mujoco_playground`; it is built on reaf-sim and MuJoCo Warp, PyTorch based), installed with its `rl` extra. It is already installed (with its caches warm) in the Python environment first on PATH: `python` imports it; do not reinstall it, and add other packages with pip only if you need them.
playground.docs: https://reaf-sim.readthedocs.io/en/latest/playground/index.html and the reaf-sim repository https://github.com/google-deepmind/reaf-sim (docs/user_guide), and the Playground source repository cloned read-only at `/refs/playground`

genesis.name: Genesis
genesis.install: Genesis is the PyPI package `genesis-world` 1.4.6 (`import genesis`), installed with PyTorch. It is already installed (with its caches warm) in the Python environment first on PATH: `python` imports it; do not reinstall it, and add other packages with pip only if you need them.
genesis.docs: https://genesis-world.readthedocs.io, and its source repository cloned read-only at `/refs/genesis`
